QuestInfo.name: Final Prescription: Tae Sang's Approval
QuestInfo.2: The fifth medicine is complete. You need all 5 that fit the prescription.

0.0: Bask in the glory that is the final medicine! Truly a masterpiece of bowel-crushing medicinal homeopathy! Take it back to the Master.

yes.0: Before you go... between us, the whole brain thing was a joke. I don't even own a brain removal machine that is sitting right behind that door!

no.0: After all we've been through and you still don't trust me?

1.0: Finally, I thought Mr. Do had roped you into one of his schemes. Was he rambling on about brains?

yes.1: You've done good work, but we still need the ingredient to bring them together. You may want to rest up. This could be dangerous.

item.0: I don't have time for this. Go back to Mr. Do and get the last medicine.
